newsitems.title: Ver. 4.6 Update Information（5★ Phantom Thief: Wavecatcher Miyu）
newsitems.author: toshiyuki.sasaki
newsitems.contents:
[h3]Event Content
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/69c4060ef04884e533aff5f78964d90f5e142f92.png"][/img]• Event: Haunted Beach Shack: Menacing Maw from the Murky Marine[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/676d1742cc97fcdddb7a5405799ced7ff0213ecc.png"][/img]
• 5★ Phantom Thief: Wavecatcher Miyu is coming to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts![/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Event: Bonus in a Bottle[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]During the event, you can choose to receive one reward each from a Seashell Bottle and a Pearl Bottle.[/p][p]The Seashell Bottle will reward you with a set of gifts including items related to Revelations.[/p][p]The Pearl Bottle will reward you with items you can use for Contracts.[/p][p]*Check in-game for more details.
[/p][h3]• Login Bonus[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Log in for 6 days during the event period to earn up to 7 Platinum Milicoins![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/961e277ce03916a3d0658336780b853284c11882.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Removal of Unlock Conditions for the Realm of Repression[/h3][p]Under the Training Materials menu, the requirements to unlock Shadows in Recollections will be removed, and you will be able to opt to unlock them even if you haven't finished the corresponding Main Story section.[/p][h3]
• New feature added to Gates of the Nightmare Catcher[/h3][p]A new Life Sustainment feature has been added to Devourer of Dreams in Gates of the Nightmare Catcher.[/p][p]When Life Sustainment is turned on, the boss's HP will not fall below 1%.[/p][p]Life Sustainment settings can be freely switched on and off during any player turn (as long as Auto-Battle is turned off). You can use this to help control when you apply Weakened to a boss.
[/p][h3]• New Item: Crystal Cognigem[/h3][p]Once you have drawn the same 5★ Phantom Thief 8 times, you can now receive Crystal Cognigems as specified below.[/p][p]*A 5★ Phantom Thief's Cognitite also counts toward this total.[/p][p]You can exchange Crystal Cognigems for valuable rewards at the Exchange Shop.[/p][p]▽ For 5★ Phantom Thieves available in Phantom Idol Draft X:[/p][p]└ For every time drawn after the 7th, receive Crystal Cognigems x4[/p][p]▽ For 5★ Phantom Thieves not available in Phantom Idol Draft X:[/p][p]└ For every time drawn after the 7th, receive Crystal Cognigems x10[/p][p]• Crystal Cognigems for Users who have Already Drawn the Same 5★ Phantom Thief 8+ times[/p][p]With the addition of this new item, following the maintenance on Jul 30, 2026, we will begin distributing Crystal Cognigems to users who already have the qualifying number of 5★ Phantom Thieves via the in-game Mail.[/p][p]*Please note that we may require up to 10 days to process distributions.[/p][p]Eligible Users:[/p][p]Players who have drawn the same 5★ Phantom Thief 8 times or more prior to the beginning of maintenance on Jul 30, 2026.[/p][p]*A 5★ Phantom Thief's Cognitite also counts toward this total.[/p][p]Distribution Details:[/p][p]Players will receive Crystal Cognigems for each time they have drawn the same 5★ Phantom Thief beyond the 7th time.[/p][p]Please refer to "New Item: Crystal Cognigem" above for details on the amount of Crystal Cognigems earned per draw.[/p][p]*If qualifying for Crystal Cognigems from both Draft X and non-Draft X Thieves, you will receive the sum of both.[/p][p]*Distribution amounts will be calculated based on Phantom Idol Draft X records as of Jul 30, 2026.
[/p][h3]• New additions to the Cognition Shop[/h3][p]Crystal Cognigems have been added to the Cognigem Exchange Shop.[/p][p]Crystal Cognigems can be exchanged for valuable rewards like Thief's Cognitite Shards, Elysian Ink or other Inks usable for customization, plus Orange Fortune Revelations, Everlasting Incense, and more.[/p][p]Elysian Ink and Prophetic Ink have also been added to the lineup for exchanging Prism Cognigems.[/p][p]*Check in-game for more details.
[/p][h3]• New Additions to the Joy Medal Exchange[/h3][p]Added the Wonder-exclusive weapon Ice Age and Ice Age Shards, the special crystals used to forge it, to the Joy Medal Exchange.
[/p][h3]• Notice: Salamander Coin Exchange Lineup Scheduling[/h3][p]The addition of Limited 5★ Weapons and Artisan's Mod Orders to the lineup of items you can exchange Salamander Coins for, as announced during Persona X-Stream Ver. 4.5 & 4.6, has been rescheduled to a later update in September.[/p][p]There will be no additions to the lineup for Salamander Coins in Ver. 4.6. We appreciate your understanding.
[/p][h3]• New Additions to the Tycoon Points Exchange[/h3][p]　▽ New Items:[/p][p]　└ Yukimi's Invite[/p][p]　└ Shiratori's Invite[/p][p]　└ Igor ♠2[/p][p]　└ Yui ♦9[/p][p]　└ Haruna ♦10
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/ca822dc6ae9032b0afe4c8f6cfe48b13f1dd1579.png"][/img]
• Limited-Time Maid for the Beach Capsule Toys in Akihabara![/h3][p]Duration: Until Sep 24, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]Fill your Display Case with these limited-time capsule toys to enjoy your collection of bikini maids anytime!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/48885c9785f10ae413abc58ad6cb3877a173a9fd.png"][/img][/p][h3]• New Bonds[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM Aug 27, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]　▽ New Side Story:[/p][p]　┗ Ichigo Shikano
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/a984f82097ed8189cf3e9e12e71652b469175533.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Phantom Pass Update[/h3][p]Season Duration: Until 1:59 AM Sep 9, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Complete the new seasonal missions to earn rewards.[/p][p]*The EXP and level of the currently active pass will be reset when the season changes at 1:59 AM on Jul 30, 2026 (UTC).
[/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

newsitems.title: Ver. 4.5 Update Information
newsitems.author: toshiyuki.sasaki
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Content[/h2][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/50b63f16c824ea54d450ab15a95c1b78d0f7c803.png"][/img]
・Event: Haunted Beach Shack: The Curse of Shirosato Beach[/h3][p]Duration: Until Jul 30, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/fb00b0fe610c312a669fe5cdcefbe3e8906c1f8b.png"][/img]
• 5★ Phantom Thief: Beachflower Minami Comes to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts![/h3][p]Duration: Until Aug 13, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.  
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/7a76860374e491077319764987f6aef5417ab214.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Thieves' Secrets: Marian's Special Missions Now Available[/h3][p]Duration: Until Jul 30, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/52595e6119cf3f7567dcbfa93e77464d086d56f0.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Special Outfit for 5★ Phantom Thief Tempest Riko![/h3][p]The Special Outfit: Summer Riko Set is now available in the shop under Goods![/p][p]To celebrate the release of this special outfit, it is available at a discounted price until 1:59 AM on Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)! During the sale, the price is reduced from 3,200 Meta Jewels to 2,880![/p][p]*This outfit cannot be used by 4★ Phantom Thief: Riko Tanemura.[/p][p]*Outfit can still be purchased after 1:59 AM on Aug 13, 2026 (UTC).[/p][p]*Check in-game for more details.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/961e277ce03916a3d0658336780b853284c11882.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Revelation Card Customization Expansion[/h3][p]You can now customize the sub-attributes of any Revelation Card using the new items Elysian Ink and Prophetic Ink.[/p][p]Use Elysian Ink to select one sub-attribute, then use Prophetic Ink to generate a value for the selected sub-attribute.[/p][p]Generating a sub-attribute consumes 1 Prophetic Ink.[/p][p]Prophetic Ink is consumed each time a sub-attribute is generated, even before customization is finalized.[/p][p]Please note that any Prophetic Ink used will not be returned if you reset the card.[/p][p]*Elysian Ink and Prophetic Ink will be added as rewards from sources such as the Premium Phantom Pass and Premium+ Phantom Pass in future updates.[/p][p]*Once customization is complete, the card's mark, set effect, main attribute, sub-attributes, and attribute values cannot be changed.[/p][p]*Check in-game for more details.
[/p][h3]• Revelation Card Customization Expansion Gift[/h3][p]Available until: Jul 30, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]To celebrate the expansion of Revelation Card customization, we are giving away 1 Vicissitude Ink, 2 Elysian Ink, and 6 Prophetic Ink.[/p][p]*You can claim this gift from your in-game Mail.[/p][p]*Gifts will be removed from your Mail after the receipt period ends regardless of whether or not they have been claimed.[/p][p]　Please be sure to claim them within the designated period.
[/p][h3]• Wingbeat Coin Giveaway[/h3][p]Distribution dates and times: Once daily at 1:00 AM after maintenance on Jul 16 through Jul 24, 2026 (UTC) (9 distributions total)[/p][p]*The first gift will be available after maintenance on Jul 16.[/p][p]Available until: 14 days after each distribution at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]As a special gift for the Ver. 4.6 update, we will distribute 100 Wingbeat Coins each day for 9 consecutive days.[/p][p]Claim every gift to receive up to 900 Wingbeat Coins, plus a variety of other items, including 1 Coffee Aid and 1 MaraThon Energy.[/p][p]*You can claim this gift from your in-game Mail.[/p][p]*Gifts will be removed from your Mail after the receipt period ends regardless of whether or not they have been claimed.[/p][p]　Please be sure to claim them within the designated period.
[/p][h3]• Login Bonus[/h3][p]Duration: Until Jul 30, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]Log in on 6 days during the event period to receive a total of 7 Platinum Tickets!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/f4e5d005b11b3b1dbe9a671c18a80e3bcb7ece3d.png"][/img][/p][h3]• New Lineup of Crane Game Limited-Time Plushies![/h3][p]Available Until: Sep 9, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]　▽ New Side Story:[/p][p]　└Lamia[/p][p]　└Mini Narcissus[/p][p]*Also available from the Prize Counter, under the Crane Game menu.[/p][p]*The Ganesha and Mini Succubus plushies will be available until maintenance begins on Jul 16.
[/p][h3]• New Synergy Stories unlocked[/h3][p]　▽ New Side Story:[/p][p]　└Minami Miyashita
[/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

[/p][h3]• New ways to obtain 5★ Phantom Thief Masaki Ashiya and his exclusive weapon[/h3][p]We've added a number of ways to get Masaki and his weapon, such as through Phantom Idol Draft X, Thief's Cognitite Shards, 5★ Cognitite Cases, and the Salamander Coin Exchange.[/p][p]*Salamander Coins can be traded for his 5★ Weapon at the Airsoft Shop in Shibuya.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/961e277ce03916a3d0658336780b853284c11882.png"][/img] • New Chat and Menu features[/h3][p]You can now customize your chat window frame, and the background design in menu screens.[/p][p]You can make any changes from the Edit Profile menu. [/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/055afdba0d9eb8ba826fb508b2c2c0ed6d06a19f.png"][/img]
• New Bonds[/h3][p]　▽ New Side Story:[/p][p]　┗ Minami Miyashita

newsitems.title: Ver. 4.2 Update Information
newsitems.author: toshiyuki.sasaki
newsitems.contents:

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/ba4c8f0b4c1c60ed5e7ca13ee1db946b86ecc2b8.png"][/img][/p][h3]• 5★ Yukari Takeba comes to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts![/h3][p]Duration: Until Jun 25, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Trials from the Sea of Souls[/h3][p]Duration: Until Jun 11, 2026 at 1:29 AM (UTC)[/p][p]Ver. 4.2's Trials from the Sea of Souls will run for one week.[/p][p]We will be adjusting the rewards accordingly to match this duration.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/961e277ce03916a3d0658336780b853284c11882.png"][/img]
• New Thieves Den Features[/h3][p]You can now collect any earned Visitor EXP and P Medals in the Thieves Den without going to the Visitors or Information menus.

[/p][h3]• New Additions to the Joy Medal Exchange[/h3][p]Added the Wonder-exclusive weapon Cyclotron and Cyclotron Shards, the special crystals used to forge it, to the Joy Medal Exchange.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/8d842eaabb3af70b6537e19ea772aa90637d5b96.png"][/img][/p][h3]• New Lineup of Crane Game Limited-Time Plushies![/h3][p]Available Until: Jul 16, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]　▽ Plushies[/p][p]　└ Ganesha[/p][p]　└ Mini Succubus[/p][p]*Also available from the Prize Counter, under the Crane Game menu.[/p][p]*Alice and Mini Decarabia plushies will be available until the start of maintenance on Jun 4.
[/p][h3]• New additions to the Tycoon Points Exchange[/h3][p]　▽ New Items[/p][p]　└ Kamiyama's Invite[/p][p]　└ Yumi's Invite[/p][p]　└ Kotone ♦7[/p][p]　└ Kurotani ♣3[/p][p]　└ Shoki ♣2
[/p][p]*The above were previously planned for Ver. 4.3, as covered on the Persona X-stream #19, but will instead be included in Ver. 4.2.[/p][h3]
• Side Story Unlocked [/h3][p]　▽ New Side Story: [/p][p]　└ Toshiya Sumi[/p][p]  [/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

newsitems.title: Ver. 4.1 Update Information
newsitems.author: toshiyuki.sasaki
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Content[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/8156f9e0a31ca8d1770a3e882f10451cb0b5ec12.png"][/img][/p][h3]• P3R Special Event: Met by Moonlight: Luminous Island[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Jun 4, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/67e02ffe2432f28e533ec49b57053b484143d323.png"][/img]
